init_distributed_process_group: initialize a torch distributed process group with a given rank and world size for multi-GPU training
destroy_distributed_process_group: destroy the default torch distributed process group after multi-GPU training is complete
check_master_process: check if the current process is the master process responsible for logging and checkpointing
scaled_all_reduce_tensors: perform a scaled all-reduce operation on tensors across GPUs and scale by inverse process group size
review_distributed_helpers: review the distributed helpers module for multi-GPU training utilities including process group management and tensor reduction
